set.body: Real processed-study response plot refuses an encoding-only not-recorded category as EmptyGroup. RealReports.bound constructs categorical levels from inventory.trials across every phase even though ReportSource queries are focal-phase outcomes. Derive automatic level domains from all declared focal-phase trials, before admission/scoring/filtering; retain focal declared empty/failed levels and all source rows. Do not discard real empty report cells or relax ParticipantMeans typed refusal. Synthetic regression should exclude reference-only levels while keeping an unadmitted focal category. Private source/plot diagnostics retained; no source data in Git.
set.title: Scope native reporting category levels to the focal trial inventory
